wa_liberty_bell_freedom_rider.descent_text: From the top, descend via the shared East Face rappel line into Beckey Gully, or downclimb the sheltered Beckey Route slab in good conditions.

wa_liberty_bell_sidewinder.descent_text: Rejoin the standard descent: two single-rope rappels off bolted/chain anchors down to the Liberty-Concord notch, then the gully back to the trail.

wa_the_exorcism_of_mark_hanna.descent_text: The route is designed for a single 70-meter-rope rappel descent back down the line.

wa_eldorado_peak_northeast_face.descent_text: From the summit, descend the East Ridge/Inspiration Glacier line (not the face) back to camp and out the approach trail.
